title: Steel Erection Services in Pakistan | Steel Mind
description: Steel Mind crews erect PEB buildings, sheds, warehouses and mezzanines on site with written lifting plans, bolt checks and strict safety rules.
h1: Steel Erection Services in Pakistan: Safe Assembly of Your Steel Building on Site
quickAnswer: Erection is the assembly of the fabricated steel on your site. Steel Mind crews work from the same drawings the factory used, follow a written lifting plan, bolt the structure to specification and fit the sheeting and accessories.
alt: Crew erecting a steel rafter with a mobile crane on a building site in Pakistan.

faq.q: Can Steel Mind erect steel it did not fabricate?
faq.a: Yes, after the engineer reviews the drawings and the site.

faq.q: What do I provide for erection?
faq.a: A clear site, truck access and a foundation that matches the anchor bolt plan.

blocks.text: Erection covers lifting the columns and rafters, bolting the frames, fitting purlins, girts and bracing, and then fitting the roof and wall sheets, doors and accessories. For mezzanines and bridges, it also covers deck, stairs and handrails.

The foundation must match the steel. Steel Mind gives your foundation contractor an anchor bolt plan. The crew checks the foundation and the bolt positions before the first lift. If a level is out, the engineer answers the same day. You provide a clear site and truck access.

items.name: Site check
items.text: Foundation levels and anchor bolts are checked against the plan.

items.name: Lifting plan
items.text: The lift plan is written and explained to the crew before work starts.

items.name: Frames
items.text: Columns and rafters are lifted and bolted in order.

items.name: Bracing and secondary members
items.text: Bracing, purlins and girts make the structure stable.

items.name: Alignment
items.text: Frames are checked for plumb and level, and bolts are tightened to the specified torque.

items.name: Sheeting and accessories
items.text: Roof and wall sheets, trims, doors, skylights and vents are fitted.

items.name: Touch-up and handover
items.text: Damaged paint is repaired and the building is checked with you.

blocks.text: Workers wear certified protective equipment and follow written site rules. Any worker may stop a job that looks unsafe. See the SME Policy.
Parts are made to the drawing and packed in erection order, so crews do not cut or rework steel on site.
